dataset: Global Solar Atlas + Global Wind Atlas
used_for: national solar suitability | PV output potential | wind screening
limitation: Resource layers need local raster ingestion. Resource quality alone does not prove grid feasibility.

dataset: Meta High Resolution Population Density – Botswana
used_for: settlement population density | spatial demand allocation | community fit
limitation: Population is a demand driver, not metered electrical demand.

used_for: 2022 population baseline | district population distribution | spatial demand-context validation
limitation: District population is a demand driver only. It is not electrical load or energy consumption.

used_for: district grid-connection rates | rural electrification gap | PV/biogas penetration | reasons households remain unconnected | household energy-use context

used_for: BESS cost range | round-trip efficiency | 4-hour duration benchmark | storage scenario economics

dataset: OpenStreetMap / HDX Botswana roads and settlements
used_for: site accessibility | settlement locations | grid-extension routing proxy

dataset: Domestic Electrical Load (DEL) Study – South Africa
used_for: future hourly residential load-shape benchmark when Botswana metering is unavailable
limitation: South African historical residential proxy. It must never be presented as measured Botswana demand; raw profile not bundled yet.
catalog_origin: External benchmark allowed because Botswana public hourly load data are missing

dataset: WRI Global Power Plant Database – Botswana rows
